description: Component-level micro-soldering, SMD hot air rework, touchscreen display folder separation and lamination, charging port replacement, and circuit diagnostics on smartphones.
daily_tasks: Heating and disassembling smartphone back panels with suction cards
Separating broken front glass folders on temperature-controlled heating plates
Desoldering burnt micro-USB and Type-C charging ports with SMD hot air rework stations
Micro-soldering replacement charging connector pins with fine iron tips and rosin flux
Testing motherboard power rails and short circuits using digital multimeters in buzzer mode
Analyzing boot current draw sequences using regulated DC benchtop power supplies
Soldering 0.02mm enameled jumper wires to bypass severed copper PCB traces
advanced_tasks: BGA chip reballing (power ICs, audio codecs, charging ICs) using precision steel stencils
Laminating curved OLED display panels in OCA vacuum autoclave chambers
Diagnosing complex secondary circuit half-shorts using rosin flux vapor smoke and thermal cameras
Restoring water-damaged motherboards with ultrasonic cleaning and descaling
equipment: OCA vacuum laminator & bubble remover autoclave
materials: Lead-free solder wire (0.3mm) and solder paste (Sn42/Bi58)
work_processes: Visual & DC Diagnostic -> Thermal Disassembly -> Motherboard Extraction -> Component Desoldering -> Micro-Soldering -> Ultrasonic Cleaning -> Reassembly & Function Testing
troubleshooting_tasks: Distinguishing between dead battery, shorted charging IC, and faulty sub-board PCB
Diagnosing touch screen digitizer non-responsiveness vs broken display flex cable
Locating VPH_PWR / VREG shorted ceramic capacitors heating up under DC supply
Resolving speaker or mic audio distortion caused by acoustic mesh debris or solder bridges
quality_inspection: Inspecting soldered connector pins under microscope for solder bridges or dry joints
Testing rapid charging current (> 1.5A) with USB digital power meters
Verifying full digitizer touch sensitivity across screen edges using touch test apps
Ensuring proximity sensor turns off screen during voice call simulations
measurement_and_planning: Regulating SMD hot air temperature (320°C–360°C) to prevent motherboard layer delamination
Setting soldering iron tip temperature (350°C) for quick thermal transfer without pad peeling
safety_practices: Wearing grounded ESD anti-static wrist strap to protect sensitive CMOS integrated circuits
Never puncturing or bending lithium-ion battery cells to avoid thermal runaway fires
Operating soldering fume absorber fans to extract hazardous rosin flux particulates
Storing lithium battery cells in fire-resistant metal containers
maintenance: Tinning soldering iron copper tips with tip activator after every repair session
Cleaning microscope objective lenses and hotplate silicone pads with isopropyl alcohol
Calibrating DC benchtop power supply voltage outputs
customer_communication: Explaining data privacy protections and guaranteeing no customer data access
Differentiating between original display folder vs first-copy replacement options
Setting transparent warranty terms on replaced charging ports and batteries

official_vocational_references.dgt_cts_trade: Technician Power Electronic System / Electronics Mechanic (CTS 026)

DC Benchtop Power Supply Motherboard Short Circuit Diagnostics
